tei:div.tei:p: "$ (253)༄༅// mai tri lugs kyi sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i sgo nas thod dbang me'i 'khor lo'i byin rlabs bya ba'i lag len bde drod dpung bskyed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(254)༄༅// na mo gu ru tsakra sam+ba rā ya/ mtshan dang rig sngags sku yi rnam 'gyur gyis// de nyid mchog tu grol ster bde ba mchog /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// snyan brgyud me dbang zab mo bklag chog dgod/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bka' srol mai tri snyan brgyud las byon pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi dngos bstan ye shes me'i dbang bskur ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro yo byad sta gon/ dngos gzhi dbang gi las rim/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams so/ dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su stegs bu bzang po dar ras kyis bkab la me tog sil ma bkram/ de'i dbus pho thad mtshan ldan chang gis bkang ba'i nang du/ sga pi pho gsum/ shing tshwa/ a ru ra/ lan tshwa cung zad/ bur sbrang rnams btab/ me long la cu gang dang sin+dhū ra chang sbyar gyis byugs la bde mchog yab yum gyi nye snying bris pas kha bcad la dar dmar gyis bkab/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod g.yon bskor du bsham/ las bum/ 'bul gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ slob dpon gyi mdun du/ nang mchod/ ḍā dril sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya'o/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ dbang don sgrub mchod dang dbang bskur ba dngos so/ dang po la bdag mdun gnyis las thog mar bdag (255) bskyed ni/ slob dpon he ru'i ka'i chas bya bar gsung kyang mi 'grub na der mos pa dang dpral bar mtsham gyis ram yig bris la 'khod/ dang po rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i yan lag rang skad cig gis he ru ka'i skur gsal bas/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs byas nas myang ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems he ru ka'i sgom bzlas rnams bde mchog yab yum spyi ltar btang*/ tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'phros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can gyis/

bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// (256)kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa rnams kyis nam mkha' khengs par gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon phul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa hūm̐/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang nas// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// bdag gis thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// byas dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i// sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jigs byed pa'i// spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni// mi bgyid pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal bla med byang chub sems// rgyal ba'i sras pos bsags pa'i dge ba gang*// de dag la ni rjes su yi rang zhing*// byang chub tu ni yang dag bdag gis bsngo// rgyal ba la sogs dkon mchog gsum po la// dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub tu ni sems bskyed de bzhin du// bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi// 'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas phrin las rnams// ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis bgyid par shog

mdun gyi lha dang bla ma rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rnal 'byor dngos la dgu las dang po 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ oṃ (257)shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ārma ko3haṃ/ sarba dharma shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ārma ko3haṃ/ rang nyid mi gnas pa'i bdag nyid can gyi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la gnas pa 'gyur/ gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ /stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i gnas su/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ nag po gcig tu gyur/ hūm̐ de las yi ge yaṃ gcig chad pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ gcig chad pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ gcig chad pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ gcig chad pa las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa laṃ gyis mtshan pa// de'i steng du suṃ gcig chad pa las byung ba'i ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ de'i steng du paṃ gcig chad pa las sna tshogs pad+ma yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ gcig chad pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i kha dog can gyi lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ badz+ra prā ka ra hūm̐ saṃ hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yaṃ ma hūm̐/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bi twa na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ gur gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bres su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra dzā la traṃ saṃ tra/ ra gur gyi phyi rol du rdo rje mda'i dra bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

phyi rol du rdo rje'i me ri kha dog rnam pa lnga rab tu 'bar ba/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i me dpung lta bus yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ gcig chad pa las 'od zer (258)'phros/ lha'i gzhal yas khang thams thad bsdus nas bh+rūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dang*/ gyen du phyogs pa'i mnga' yab mdzes pas bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol nas 'dod yon gyi stegs bu la 'khod pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams mchod pa 'bul ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa/ dbus 'phyur bur gyur ba'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo'i thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che'i gdugs/ ri dwags pho mo dang*/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang*/ me tog gis phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas mdzes par byas pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyir rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi bzad pa/ nub byang du kī li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa'o// de rnams la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing chen po brgyad/

zhing skyong ba brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ rnal 'byor brgyad/ gzhan yang ri dang mchod rten me brgyad chu grub pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ dam tshig la (259)spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za srin po'i tshogs dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ ro'i tshogs kyis gang bas bskor ba'o/ gsum pa 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og rnams shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba mthing kha'i steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ā+ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ phrag gnyis g.yon du 'khor ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis gnyis g.yas su 'khor ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du rang gi sems rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid nam mkha'i hūm̐ sngon po zhugs/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ bzhi pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral (260)pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ske rag dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ thod pa dum bu'i ske rags can/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// shar sgo khwa gdong ma nag mo// byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang (261)khu/ nub sgo khyi gdong ma dmar mo// lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo// shar lhor gshin rje ma brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/

nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag tu lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ lnga ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ gtso bo la oṃ haḥsnying khar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa hā hu spyi bor rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ bau ṣa ṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing kha/ phaṭa haṃ yan lag dang nyid lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang khu ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum la oṃ baṃ lte bar phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yauṃ snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ mauṃ khar rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ dpral bar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi bor skrag byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭa phaṭa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa// (262)mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po/ rna bar hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ sna la khaṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu/ lce la maṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar trāṃ las ser sna rdo rje ser po/ snying gar ham las dbang phyug rdo rje sngon po/

thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas bskor ba dbang gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sbyor mtshams nas rig pa'i lha mo bdud rtsis bkang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i chus lus gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ sgo ma bzhi la snang ba mtha' yas/ mtshams ma bzhi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bdun pa mchod pa'i rnal 'byor ni/

thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan dang*/ bde ba'i yo byad thams cad bsdus/ zhal nas zhugs pa thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba byang chub sems kyi rnam par rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar lhung bas (263)mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par gyur pa sbyor 'tshams nas byung bas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang mchod par bsam la / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa 'i nyer spyod rol mo bcas pa dang*/ oṃ ā:badz+ra ā dar+sha pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ des 'gres te/ wi ṇe gan+dhe/ ra sa// spar+she/ zhes 'dod yon lngas mchod/ de nas lha mo mchod rdzas dang bcas pa gtso bo yab yum la thim pas/ gtso bo yab yum mchog tu bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i dbyings su thim pa na// 'khor gyi lha mo bcu gnyis kyis gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bstod cing bskul ba ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs la bde legs thob// der ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro rnams dag /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad cing*// sgyu ma'i sprul pas don kun grub mdzad pa// mgon po bde mchog dpal ldan dgyes par bzhengs// zhes gsol ba btab pa na chos kyi sku las sgyu ma lta bur sngon bzhin du bzhengs te/ rnam par rol pa mtha' yas pas sems can gyi don mdzad par bsam mo// de nas/ mdun du yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa'i log gsum la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a yig las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mūṃ dang go las dri chu dang ba glang gi sha hūm̐ dang mūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ shar du bi dang na las dri chen dang mi'i sha oṃ dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor ra dang ku las rak+ta dang khyi'i sha trāṃ dang lam gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu shu dang da las byang sems dang rta'i sha āṃ dang pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du ma dang ha las māṃ sa dang glang po che'i sha khaṃ dang tāṃ gyis (264)mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bdag gis thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me 'bar ba thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams 'khol// dam tshig gi bdud rtsir zhu/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phogs de las 'od 'phros pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis sbyor 'tshams nas byang chub kyi sems phab/ rdo rje'i sbu gu nas mar thim/ zla ba'i kha bkab kyang zhu/ rdo rje des lan gsum dkrugs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres shing rdo rje yang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur te rim pa bzhin gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba rgyud la skyes par bsam pa ni bdud rna myang ba'o// brgyad pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor ni chags grol gyi lam gnyis gang rung bsgom pa'o// dgu pa nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor ni/ bsam mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdus la mnyam par bzhag /yan lag bzlas pa'i rim pa bya ba la/ lhar lha'i skur gsal bar bltas la byin gyis brlabs pa'i thod phreng lag g.yon pas bzung la/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor bas 'od zer sngags phreng gi rnam par lta bu byung nas/

rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar song ba a wa dhū ti'i lam nas byung ste/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs shing hūm̐ gi nā da la thim par bsams te/ dbang gi snying po ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ nye snying ni/ oṃ hriḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye snying ni/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor sngags (265) ni/ oṃ ḍā ki nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka kā s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ū lu kā s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa na ka s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka ra s+yai huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma dā ḍhi yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū ti yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso bo yab yum ci 'grub dang 'khor sngags rnams kyang cung zad re bzla/ 'dir rkang brgyad sngon du 'gro ba'i rtsa sngags dang go cha'i sngags rnams kyang bzla bar gsungs pas 'grub na de ltar bya'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ sum+bha ni sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun rten thod pa bde ba skyed pa'i snod shin tu yangs pa'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ chad ces pa rnams dor/ byang ljang ba'i kha dog can gyi lte bar bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang sogs nas/ lte ba mthing kha'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sogs nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/

bar gong ltar/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dbang gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor nas ni// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ.oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis (266)mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ bar phrang sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ bsang sbyangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi= de bzhin= shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon phul/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dkyil 'khor= /yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje= /bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen= /nam mkha'= dhū pe= dkyil 'khor= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje= /mar mes gang ba'i= /nam mkha'= ā lo ke= /dkyil 'khor= /gdud sel ljang khu= /dri mchog byug pa'i rin chen= /nam mkha'= gan+dhe= dkyil 'khor= zhal zas ser mo rdo rje= bdud rtsis gang bas= nam mkha' gang bas= nai wi d+ya= dkyil 'khor= sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje= /pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma/ nam mkha' gang = oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes nyer spyod lnga rol mor bcas pa dang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul// gzugs mdzes dkar mo me long pad+ma'i snod// cang te'u'i sgra 'khrol kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten ma// nam mkha'=

oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā dar+sha pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba rnams= dbyangs snyan sngon mo pi waṃ pad+ma'i snod/ cang te'u'i= nam mkha'= wī ṇe= rgyal ba= dri ldan ser mo sgos khang pad+ma'i snod/ cang te'u= nam mkha'= gan+dhe= rgyal ba= bcud ldan dmar mo bza' btung pad+ma'i snod/ cang te'u= nam mkha'= ra sa= rgyal ba=(267)bde ldan ljang khu ras bzang pad+ma'i snod/ cang te'u= nam mkha' gang bas= spar+she= zhes 'dod yon gyis lha mos mchod/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te wi re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpā sni san+ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭa mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭa ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu kha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa hā sra bhu dza bhā su ra ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pa sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭāṅga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā bh+rā dzi nāṃ ba ra dhā ra ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhū mran+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wa rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa rā dzi te tre lo kya mā te ma hā bid+ya shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kre dhe ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+waṃ bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā ra hi ma hā yo gi ni ka me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sam/ yang na/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa bod skad gang rigs kyis bstod do// gsum pa las bum sgrub pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung (268)gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig las mi nyung ba bzla/ mthar/ mgon po bdag ni sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur bar bsgom la/ tshogs bsang sbyang*/ bdag bskyed kyi bdud rtsi'i skabs ltar byin brlab/ 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas bla ma dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod par bsam zhing rol mo dang bcas pas/ tshogs 'khor rgyas pa'i skabs/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba/ zhes shis brjod/ gsung srol yod pa sogs spro na bya/ bsdu na/ gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya 'dod yon rnam lnga 'di// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul// thim pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ gzugs dang = reg bya 'dod yon= rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thim pa'i tshul gyis=

ga ṇa tsakra pū dzaḥ de bzhin thog ma'i rkang pa gnyis dang*/ mtha' ma'i rkang pa gnyis 'dra ba la/ yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul// chos skyong srung ma rnams la 'bul// phyogs skyong zhing skyong rnams la 'bul// gzhi bdag gnas bdag rnams la 'bul// rdo rje spun grogs rnams la 'bul/ zhes sbyar la tshogs 'bul lo// gnyis pa dbang dngos ni/ snod du rung ba'i slob ma rnams/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs las bum chus khrus bya/ gral la 'khod (269) bla ma he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bgegs gtor/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs/ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ bden pa bdar ba ni/ phaṭaḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= ma gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi= dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden po chen po de'i byin rlabs dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pas ding 'dir slob ma rnams la ye shes me'i byin rlabs zab mo bgyi ba la/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa sngags nyan pa la mi dbang zhing*/ phyag rgya lta ba la mi dbang ba'i bdud bgegs bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di khyer la myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes bgegs gtor btang nas/ oṃ hrīḥha ha sogs yi dam gyi gzungs sngags dang*/ sum+bha ni brjod cing*/ gu gul gyi dud pa btang*/ thun gyi brab te bgegs skrad/ bla mas/ bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams la ye shes kyi drod la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces bla ma dang lha la gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ drang nges kyi chos bshad ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ khyad par/ de la 'dir skabs su babs pa/ mtshan nyid rgyu'i theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa la'ang rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa las mchog dang phul du gyur pa bde (270)dgyes gtso bor gyur pa'i bla med ma rgyud rnams kyi rdzogs rim bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes skyed pa'i thabs lam rnams kyi rtsa ba lhan skyes tsaṇ+ḍa lī sgom pa la gegs sel zhing bogs myur du thon pa sogs yon tan gyi rtsal skyed pa la/ mchog tu bsngags pa la rdo rje'i tshig rkang las khyad par drod kyi dbang bskur ces dngos su bstan pa'i gdams ngag grub thob brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byon pa ste/ de'ang rgyud dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi gdams pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zhes bka' brgyud rin po che rnams la yongs su grags pa'i bka' srol phyi ma 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs ring brgyud rdo rje 'chang*/ sha ba ri pa/ me tri pa/ ti pu dre med bshes gnyen/ ras chung pa sogs las brgyud de dpal ldan 'brug pa bka' brgyud las bar ma chad par byon pa dang*/ nye brgyud rje btsun ye shes kyi sku brnyes pa ras chung rdo rje grags pas mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon pos 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa la dngos su stsal ba rdo rje 'chang gis gsang tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa mai trī snyan brgyud las byon pa thod dbang me'i 'khor lo'i byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams tshul bzhin grub pa lags/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes mtshams sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhar mos gdung rtse gcig pas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// phag mo lhan cig yang dag sbyor// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub (271)sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grang mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ bla mas/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas snod rung du gyur pa la sdom pa bsgrag pa yin pas 'di la gsan 'tshal/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes grags so// blo chen khyod kyis bzung bya ste// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor ba mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do// ji ltar bsgrags pa'i sdom pa de rnams tshul bzhin gsungs pas/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo rgyud la skye ba'i skal ldan du 'gyur ba yang*/

ji skad du dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar// bsrungs pas rim gnyis lam gyi snod 'gyur zhing*// skye shi bar do'i mun pa kun sel 'gyur// zhes pa'i don yid dang 'dres nges par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos lan (272)gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas ye shes pa'i byin rlabs dbab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po/ sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// gtso bo la oṃ ha snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po sogs nas thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum la oṃ baṃ lte bar phag mo dmar mo sogs nas thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs ba'i mos pas/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor nas ni// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ yab yum gyis snying po nye snying gi mthar/ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes drag tu brjod cing ḍā dril bskrol ba dang bstun/

slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i dmigs 'dun bskyed/ slob ma rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro hā+e sa bsang la/ khyed rang (273)rnams skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthong su 'phyar ba/ rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang srog bral ba'i snying gar mnan te ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ/ khar hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa rnams gsal thob/ slob ma rnams kyi dbus su bla mas rdo rje gdengs te yi ge bdun pa lan lnga bdun gang rung brjod rjes/ rdo rje spyi bor 'jog pa dang bstun/ deng khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas ji ltar bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyed kyi nga la brnyas par ma byed/ khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes dam bsgrag dbang bskur dngos gzhi la/ lus la me yi byin rlabs zhu snyam pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yis// bdag gi lus la ye shes kyi// me yi byin rlabs stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros thod pa'i nang gi yi dam yab yum gyi sku'i byin rlabs me'i rang bzhin oṃ gyi rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi sku rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres (274)pa khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pa'i mos pa gyis/

oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ zhes nye snying brjod cing*/ thod pas dpral mtshams su dbang bskur zhing rol mo sgrog gu gul gyi dud pas bdug dpal 'bar ram gyis mtshan pa lus la bskor bas lus me'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzñā na dz+wa la raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dpal 'bar lus la bskor/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs pas sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsung gi byin rlabs zhu snyam pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yis// bdag gi ngag la ye shes kyi// me yi byin rlabs stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ thod pa'i nang gi yi dam gyi gsung gi byin rlabs me yi rang bzhin āḥ'i rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi gsung rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ.i hrīḥswā/ zhes thod pas mgrin par dbang bskur zhing rol mo dang dud pa bya/ de nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces 'tshams sbyar nas slob dpon gyis phreng ba nas bzung du bcug la/ yi dam yab yum gyi nye snying lan/ kha shas bgrang bu bcug /bdud rtsi thur mgo re ster/ dpal 'bar raṃ gyis mtshan pa ngag la bskor bas ngag rlung ye shes me yi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzñān dz+wa la ri su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ brjod cing dpal 'bar bskor/ de ltar dbang bskur bas gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs pas gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhu snyam pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yis/ (275)bdag gi yid la ye shes kyi// me yi byin rlabs stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros thod pa'i nang gi yi dam yab yum gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs me'i rang bzhin hūm̐ gi rnam pa 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam zhi khro rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi thugs rdo rje dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thod pa snying gar 'jog pa dang rol mo/ dud pa bya/ de nas/ dpal 'bar ram gyis mtshan pa yid la bskor bas ye shes me'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzña na dz+wa la raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes dpa' 'bar bskor/ de ltar dbang bskur bas thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs pas thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i byin rlabs zhu snyam pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yis// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la// ye shes me yi byin rlabs stsol/ lan gsum/ thod pa'i nang gi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum 'od du zhu ba las ye shes me'i bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur pa khyed rang rnams la byin pas sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa gnas gsum du gtugs nas yi ge gsum brjod cing rol mo dang dud pa bya/ bdud rtsi sbyin/ dpal 'bar ram gyis mtshan pa lus la bskor bas lus ngag yid gsum ye shes me'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzñā na dz+wa la raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya sā hā/ zhes brjod cing dpal 'bar bskor/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs sgo gsum la zhugs pas 'pho med bde chen thob pa'i skal ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

des dbang dngos song nas dbang don (276)gyi ye shes ngo sprod pa la/ lus gnad/ rlung gnad/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum las/ lus gnad ni/ lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung*// sgal tshig rin chen rtsal la brgyus// mthong kha rgyun du yangs pa dang*// stong sgo shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni yar rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte 'og btsir// mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar// rlung sems dril la drag tu gcun// rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rkang pa g.yas steng du bton pa'i rdo rje skyil krung*/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu bcas pa'i gru mos stod gcun/ sgal tshigs dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrang*/ mthong kha rgyun du yangs par bya/ og skos mdud mnan/ lce yar rkan la gtad pa'i mig gnyis sna rtse'am/ thad ka'i bar snang la blta ba'i rnam snang chos bdun legs par bca' dgos pas lus gnad de ltar mdzad par zhu/ zhes lus gnad de ltar 'char gzhug de nas rlung gnad la/ sngon 'gro 'bud ba dgu phrugs ni/ g.yas nas g.yon/ g.yon nas g.yas/ dbus nas thad dkar gtad nas 'jam po mis mi tshor ba gsum/ drag po gsum/ gcud cing 'bud pa gsum ste dgu phrugs su bus shig ces slob dpon gyis bslab la rlung ro 'bud/ dngos gzhi sbyor ba bzhi ldan la// rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// 'phang bar bya dang rnam pa bzhi/ zhes pa'i don ni phyi'i sor bcu drug tsam gyi thad nas sgra med du sna gnyis kyi nang du gzhug pa rngub pa/ de lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then nas kha sbyor du 'dzin pa dgang ba dang*/ mi thub la khad pa dang rngub chung byas/ g.yas bcag g.yon bcag cha mnyam du bcag pa gzhil ba/ de nas mi thub la khang pa dang sna gnyis nas dang po dang mjug tu shed chung zhing*/ bar du shugs che (277)bar dbyung ba mda' ltar 'phang ba ste sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas rlung khug pa bcu re 'dzin par zhu/

zhes slob dpon dang lhan cig 'dzin/ de nas dmigs pa'i gnad ni khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i mos pas gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs 'di bzhin lhan cig tu gsung bar zhu/ 'khor lo sdom pa dpal ldan sha wa ri// ras chung pa dang 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags// tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang mi pham pad+ma dkar// chos kyi mgon po ngag dbang bzang po'i zhabs// mi pham blo gros kun dga' lhun grub dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug dge legs bzhad pa'i zhabs// 'jam mgon dgyes pa 'jam dpal dpa' bo dang*// chos kyi snang ba ye shes grub pa la// gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung byin gyis rlobs// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ lan bcu brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas 'khor lo sdom pa nas bzung brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la so sor thim pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med kyi ngos nas/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ des gtum mo'i me dbang du grags pa'i byin rlabs legs par thob pa yin pas/ dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig rnams ma nyams par bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar byas la slob ma byes so/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams brda'i 'bul len byas la nang gi sregs blugs kyi longs spyad nas lhag ma logs su bzhag gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ chu chad nang mchod bran la bsang sbyang*/ bdud rtsi ltar byin rlabs bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri (278)rab dang bcas pa'i steng du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas te dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/

'bar ba'i phyag rgya lta stangs bcas/ pheṃ pheṃ brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ā kar+dha ya ā kar+dha ya/ pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/ bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī hṛ da ya/ a pa to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi ni swa bhā wa ārma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas lan gsum dang*/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs te sprin gtibs pa bzhin mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ pang skor byed cing yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ rgyas par 'khor sngags rnams la sngags btags pa brjod/ bsdu na snga mas chog mthar 'khyud rgya dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi lha gtso 'khor dpag tu med pa byon nas lha so so la thim par bsam/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sbu gu can du gyur par gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/

gtso bo'i snying po nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar gyi sngags lan gsum gyis 'bul// shes na phreng sngags kyang brjod/ gtor ma'i steng rim nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i tshul gyis gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam la/ de nas/ oṃ/ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig dang*// ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang gzhi bdo zhing dang ni// khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*// sems can smod dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chu la gnas// nag po drag po drag chen po// lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang*// nag po gtsigs dang mi sdug dang*// rga las 'das dang log 'dren dang*// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang*// rgyal (279)dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// dreg tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen ma// thod phreng phreng dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /sprul chen ral gri dgra s+t+wa can// rdo rje de ni gzhu can ma// de nyid chen mo'i mkha' 'gro lnga// las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /bcom ldan 'khor lo bde mchog la// dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor// rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor dang bcas// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas// lha chen brgyad po= klu chen brgyad po= gza' chen brgyad po= rgyu skar nyer brgyad= de la sogs te mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/

yi dwags tshogs rnams= gnod sbyin tshogs rnams= srin po'i= sha za'i= smyo byed= rjed byed= ma lus ji snyed yod pa kun// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig ces pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ zhes 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa rnams la bstim la/ de nas mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje spu bu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba ya k+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+mā da/ a pasmā ra/ badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā (280)ki n+ya da ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the bam̐/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ bi wa tha/ dzigh+ra tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shrād+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul bas tshims par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ rnam lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan ldan mgon po dpa' bo chen po ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i gzugs// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo kho mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/

zhes brjod/ srid dang zhi la chags rnams kun tu rtog pa'i rlabs bcom zhing*/ khyod ni dngos kun rang bzhin mkha' ltar gzigs pa nyid gyur kyang*// snying rje lci ba'i chu yis rab rgyas thugs kyi mtsho ldan mgon// lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma (281)ya sogs/ zhes yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// mchod sbyin 'di yi mthu stobs kyis// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog zhes phrin las bcol/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad gyur pa'i// lam de nyid la zhugs nas kyang*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog zhes smon lam gdab par byas la/ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams bdag nyid la thim zhing*/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// de nas spro na chos srung gtor 'bul kyang bya/ de nas lhag gtor la myos byed kyi kha phru gdab la hūm̐ brjod/ 'bar ba'i rgya dang*/ pheṃ/ zhes pas mgon dgug ste/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams dang*/ 'byung po thams cad mdun du spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis snod thod pa dang bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ a kā ro'am/ oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣe bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas tshim par bsams la lhag gtor phyi rol du bskyal/ theg chen thun mongs ma yin pa'i smon lam rgya cher gdas/

de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// grub par stsal lam byon pa bzhin// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad par zhu// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'di'i// ma tshangs pa dag (282)bzod par gsol// zhi dang bkra shis bde legs shog /yon bdag don khyed byas nas su// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzod cig muḥ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing*// ma 'tshal ba dang ma rnyed dang*// ma tshangs pa dang lhag gyur pa// byas pa de mi bzod par gsol// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba rnams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang*// de ni lha mos bzod par gsol// mnga' bdag ma yis gnang ba zhu// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig zhes brjod de rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad 'od du zhu nas dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de gdan la/ de lha so so la/ lha sgo ma bzhi phyogs ma bzhi la/ mtshams ma bzhi thod pa bzhi la/ phyogs ma bzhi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/ thod pa bzhi gtso bo'i thugs kar thim zhing*/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das yab yum du gsal ba'i snying khar rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ dpral bar rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma he ser po// tshogs mar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag gong gnyis su he ru ka'i ngo bo bau ṣa ṭa he nag po/ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ho mthing ga /yan lag thams cad la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/

yum gyi lte bar phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo haṃ yau sngon mo/ khar rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hrī mi dkar mo/ dpral bar skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hri hriṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ yan lag thams (283)cad la tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha/ spyi bor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i gzugs can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i bdag nyid can no// de nas spyod lam brtan pa ni/ tshul khrims tsan dan yan lag byugs// bsam gtan stod g.yogs kyis dkris pa// byang chub yan lag me tog bkram// ji ltar bde bar spyod par bya'o// zhes don nges pas thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug cing*/ shis brjod rgyas par byas la me tog gi char dbab bo/ 'di'i 'don chog spros pa rgyas par 'dod na rgyal dbang 'brug pa yab sras kyi gsung las shes dgos shing don gyi snying po 'dir bstan la ma tshang med do/ dam tshig gtum mos snyigs ma'i phung khams bsregs// ye shes me lces bdag 'dzin bud shing bcom// bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur phyag rgya che'i// dngos grub tshe 'dir 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'i tshul 'dir yig chas phongs par ma gyur kyang*/ skal ldan yongs la 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i sgor 'gyur bar re ba'i lhag blos kun nas bslangs te/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes gong ma'i gsungs las khyer bde ba'i lag len tu rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ/ (284)
